description_zh: 查询媒体工作流执行实例
name: QueryMediaWorkflowExecutionList

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the media workflow execution instances. To obtain the instance ID, log on to the ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) console and choose Workflows > Execution Instances in the left-side navigation pane. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can query a maximum of 10 media workflow execution instances at a time
parameters.help_zh: 媒体工作流执行实例ID列表，可以通过MPS控制台 > 工作流管理 > 执行实例获取。使用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多查询10个。
parameters.name: run_ids

MediaWorkflowExecution.description_en: The details of the media workflows

items.description_en: The information about the media workflow

Activity.description_en: The methods that are called in the media workflow

Code.description_en:
The error code.

This parameter is returned only if Fail is returned for the State parameter.
This parameter is not returned if the method status is Success
Code.description_zh:
错误码。

当活动状态是Fail时，会给出具体的错误码。

当活动状态是Success时，不返回此参数

EndTime.description_en: The time when the method ends

JobId.description_en: The IDs of the jobs that are generated when the methods are called, such as the job IDs for the analysis, transcode, and snapshot methods
JobId.description_zh: 活动执行时生成的作业ID（例如分析作业ID、转码作业ID、截图作业ID）

MNSMessageResult.description_en: The message sent by Message Service (MNS) to notify the user of the job result
MNSMessageResult.description_zh: MNS通知用户作业完成结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the MNS message fails to be sent. This parameter is not returned if the MNS message is sent
ErrorCode.description_zh: 执行失败时错误码。如果执行成功则不返回此参数
ErrorCode.example: The Topic/Queue config is empty, not send message

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the MNS message fails to be sent. This parameter is not returned if the MNS message is sent
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 执行失败时错误信息。如果执行成功则不返回此参数

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the message that indicates the MNS message is sent. This parameter is not returned if the MNS message fails to be sent
MessageId.description_zh: 执行成功时消息的ID。如果执行失败则不返回此参数

Message.description_en:
The error message.

This parameter is returned only if Fail is returned for the State parameter.
This parameter is not returned if the method status is Success
Message.description_zh:
错误信息。

当活动状态是Fail时，会给出详细的错误描述信息。

当活动状态是Success时，此参数不返回
Message.example: The resource operated InputFile is bad

Name.description_en:
The name of the method.

The name of each method in a media workflow is unique
Name.description_zh:
媒体工作流活动名称。

在同一个工作流中活动的名字是唯一的

StartTime.description_en: The time when the method is called

State.description_en:
The status of the workflow method. Valid values:

Running: The method is being called.
Success: The method is called.
Fail: The method failed to be called.
Skipped: The method is skipped.

For example, after the analysis is complete, the transcode method is called and high-definition and standard-definition transcoding jobs are created. The system determines whether to run the jobs based on the analysis result. If the resolution of the input video is low, the high-definition transcoding job may be skipped
State.description_zh:
状态。取值：

Running：活动执行中。

Success：活动执行成功。

Fail：活动执行失败。

Skipped：活动被跳过。

例如：分析活动之后有高清、标清两个转码活动，会根据实际分析的结果来决策，如果原视频内容清晰度不够，高清的转码活动就可能被跳过

Type.description_en: The methods that are supported in the media workflow. Valid values: Start, Snapshot, Transcode, Analysis, and Report. For more information, see [Methods supported for media workflows]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68494.html）
Type.description_zh: 媒体工作流活动类型。可取值：Start活动、Snapshot活动、Transcode活动、Analysis活动、Report活动。更多活动信息请参见[媒体工作流活动介绍]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68494.html）

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the media workflow was created

Input.description_en: The input data of the media workflow
Input.description_zh: 媒体工作流的用户自定义数据

InputFile.description_en: The input file of the media workflow
InputFile.description_zh: 媒体工作流的输入文件

Bucket.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket in which the input file is stored

Location.description_en: The ID of the OSS region in which the input file resides

Object.description_en: The name of the OSS object that is used as the input file

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the media asset. A media file contains all the information about a media workflow
MediaId.description_zh: 媒体ID。媒体工作流生成的所有信息都属于这个媒体ID

MediaWorkflowId.description_en: The ID of the media workflow

Name.description_en: The name of the media workflow

RunId.description_en: The ID of the execution instance

State.description_en:
The status of the media workflow. Valid values:

Running: The media workflow is running.
Completed: The media workflow is complete.

Completed only indicates that the media workflow is complete. View the status of each method in the workflow, such as the transcode and snapshot methods, to check whether the method is called.

Fail: The media workflow fails
State.description_zh:
状态。取值：

Running：执行中。

Completed：执行完成。

Completed仅表示工作流执行完成，每个活动的（转码、截图等）是否成功要看每个活动具体的状态值。

Fail：执行失败

RunId.description_en: The IDs of the execution instances that do not exist
RunId.description_zh: 不存在的媒体工作流实例列表

items.description_en: The IDs of the execution instances that do not exist. null is returned if all specified execution instances exist
items.description_zh: 不存在的执行实例ID。如果没有则此参数不返回
